title: Deus — Logs
description: Application logs of the deus services and the browser from VictoriaLogs: volume and error trends, message patterns, what failing records have in common, pods and versions, one request across services and the explorer.

list.name: request
list.label: Request (latest first)

query.query: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($level) trace_id:* | sort by (_time desc) | limit 30 | format "<_time>" as t | replace ("T", " ") at t | replace_regexp ("\\.[0-9]+Z$", " UTC") at t | format "<t> · <service.name> · <_msg> · <trace_id>" as option

list.definition: option: latest records with a trace ID

list.name: Critical alerts
list.expr: max by (alertname, target, slo, deployment) (ALERTS{alertname=~"Deus.*", alertstate="firing", severity="critical"})

list.name: Node restarts
list.expr: (max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)) > max_over_time((max by (node) (label_replace(node_boot_time_seconds, "internal_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.+):[0-9]+") * on (internal_ip) group_left (node) max by (internal_ip, node) (kube_node_info)))[30m:1m] offset 1m)) * on (node) group_left (label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) max by (node, label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool, label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning) (kube_node_labels)
list.textFormat: Pool {{label_cloud_google_com_gke_nodepool}} ({{label_cloud_google_com_gke_provisioning}}): spot preemption, upgrade or repair; its pods were rescheduled

list.name: Container restarts
list.expr: (changes(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"}[1m]) > 0) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left (reason) max by (namespace, pod, container, reason) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"(.+-)?deus"})

panels.title: Log records
panels.description: Records the selected services logged in the time range (all levels).

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: WARN records: mostly rejected requests (validation, unknown document, business rules), see Patterns.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=WARN | stats count() warnings

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: ERROR records: a request or a background job failed for a technical reason.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=ERROR | stats count() errors

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of ERROR records among all records of the selected services.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats count() if (severity_text:=ERROR) errors, count() lines | math errors*100/lines as error_ratio | delete errors, lines

panels.title: Services logging errors
panels.description: Services with at least one ERROR record. Several at the same time usually means a shared dependency: the database, a called service, the network.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=ERROR | stats count_uniq(service.name) services

panels.title: Browser errors
panels.description: Errors the web app reported from users' browsers: unhandled exceptions, failed loads and failed requests.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus telemetry.source:=browser severity_text:=ERROR | stats count() errors

panels.title: Records by level
panels.description: Log records of the selected services per interval by level, after the message search.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats by (severity_text) count() lines

panels.title: Error ratio by service
panels.description: Share of ERROR records per service. A service with more traffic does not look worse here; compare with the Errors per service timeline below.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats by (service.name) count() if (severity_text:=ERROR) errors, count() lines | math round(errors*100/lines, 0.01) as error_ratio | delete errors, lines

panels.title: Errors per service
panels.description: ERROR records per service and interval, only for the services that logged errors in the time range (its migration job included): when each started and stopped failing, and which failed first. Hover a cell for the count. Rollouts and critical alerts are marked on the graphs above.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=ERROR | copy service.name as service | replace_regexp ("-migrations$", "") at service | stats by (service) count() errors

panels.title: Errors by service
panels.description: ERROR records per service in the time range, its migration job included, most first. Click a service for Deus — Service.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:=ERROR | copy service.name as service | replace_regexp ("-migrations$", "") at service | stats by (service) count() errors | sort by (errors desc)

panels.title: Message patterns
panels.description: What the selected records say, grouped by pattern (numbers and IDs replaced), with the cause (exception.message). Click a message to keep only its records.

value.title: Show only lines with this message

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($level) | copy service.name as service, severity_text as level, exception.message as err | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\\b", "<ID>") at err | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9]+\\b", "<N>") at _msg | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9]+\\b", "<N>") at err | extract_regexp "^(?P<search_key>[^<]*)" from _msg | stats by (service, level, _msg, err, search_key) count() lines, count_uniq(k8s.pod.name) pods, min(_time) first, max(_time) last | total_stats sum(lines) total | math round(lines*100/total, 0.01) as share, round(first/1e6) as first_ms, round(last/1e6) as last_ms | delete total, first, last | sort by (lines desc) | limit 50

panels.title: Patterns over time
panels.description: The same patterns per interval: a new pattern appearing, or one jumping, marks the start of a problem.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($level) | copy service.name as service, severity_text as level, exception.message as err | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\\b", "<ID>") at err | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9]+\\b", "<N>") at _msg | replace_regexp ("\\b[0-9]+\\b", "<N>") at err | stats by (service, _msg) count() lines

panels.title: What these records have in common
panels.description: Most frequent values of each field in the selected records and the share carrying them. One route, error code, pod, node or version near 100% points at the cause.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($level) | delete _msg, exception.message, exception.stacktrace, exception.cause, _time, _stream, _stream_id, trace_id, span_id, k8s.pod.uid, k8s.replicaset.uid, k8s.replicaset.name, k8s.pod.start_time, k8s.cluster.uid, k8s.namespace.name, k8s.container.name, service.namespace, service.instance.id, deployment.environment.name, container.image.name, scope.version, severity_number | facets 5 keep_const_fields | stats by (field_name, field_value) sum(hits) lines | format if (field_name:=severity_text) "<lines>" as level_lines | total_stats sum(level_lines) total | math round(lines*100/total, 0.1) as share | delete level_lines, total | filter -field_name:=severity_text | sort by (share desc) | limit 60

panels.title: Records by pod
panels.description: One pod, node or version with more errors than its peers points at the pod, the node or a rollout rather than the code path. Click a pod to list its records in the explorer.

value.title: Show this pod's lines in the explorer

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` | stats by (k8s.pod.name, k8s.node.name, service.version) count() lines, count() if (severity_text:=WARN) warnings, count() if (severity_text:=ERROR) errors | math round(errors*100/lines, 0.01) as error_ratio | sort by (errors desc, warnings desc) | limit 30

panels.title: Warnings and errors by version
panels.description: Records per image version (service.version). A new version bringing new errors shows here at the rollout.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in(ERROR, WARN) | stats by (service.version, severity_text) count() lines

panels.title: All records of one request, oldest first
panels.description: Every service's records with the trace ID picked in the Request variable. The panel link opens the trace.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus trace_id:="${request:raw}" trace_id:* | format if (exception.message:*) "<_msg> — <exception.message>" as _msg | format "[<service.name>] <_msg>" as _msg

links.title: Open the trace in Deus — Traces

panels.title: Records — $level
panels.description: Expand a record for its fields; trace_id links to the trace. Narrow with Message contains and Filters (any field).

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) _msg:~`(?i)\Q${search:raw}\E` severity_text:in($level) | format if (exception.message:*) "<_msg> — <exception.message>" as _msg | format "[<service.name>] <_msg>" as _msg

panels.title: Log pipeline — is every record arriving?
Last record per service
panels.description: When each service last logged. Services log every rejected or failed request and the outbox relay's work; one that stops logging while it serves traffic has lost its OTLP export or hangs.

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) | stats by (service.name) max(_time) last, count() lines | math round(last/1e6) as last_ms | delete last

panels.title: Log bytes by service
panels.description: Uncompressed size of all fields per interval: who drives log volume (storage and cost).

targets.expr: service.namespace:=deus service.name:in($service) | stats by (service.name) sum_len(*) bytes
